packages.name: Reclaim
packages.notes:
0.1.1-1577
- Rebuilt with SDK/CLI/templates 0.15.1 and UI 0.11.5 for all three architectures.
- control.sh refusals remove staged .executor/.policy.json copies and include SynoReclaim in the log.
- Administrator action required after upgrade: task definitions changed. Open Syno Reclaim and approve system access once again. Retained reports and settings are preserved.
- Reclaim does not use AboutDialog and adds no default Terms of Service or Privacy Policy links.
- Known limitation: a cold rootfs report may exceed the CLI's 10-second synchronous request deadline.

packages.name: Connect
packages.notes:
0.1.0-0057
- Rebuild with SDK/CLI/templates 0.15.1 and UI 0.11.5.
- SDK control.sh refusals remove staged .executor / .policy.json and log the package name. Changed executor task definitions require one administrator reapproval after upgrade for Apps using the executor; Connect has no executor or approval flow.
- AboutDialog no longer supplies default Terms of Service / Privacy URLs. Connect and its SDK AppShell do not use AboutDialog and display no legal links.

packages.name: Download Hub
packages.notes:
0.2.2-0044
- Rebuilt with CLI/SDK/templates 0.15.1 and UI 0.11.5.
- Upgrade requires an administrator to approve the changed executor task definitions once again in Settings before background saves resume. Upgrade directly; do not uninstall first.
- Refused control.sh clears temporary .executor/.policy.json and logs the package name.
- UI no longer supplies default legal links. Download Hub does not use AboutDialog; no App-specific legal URLs are configured.
- Local/kuma verification only; NAS upgrade, reapproval and refusal handling still require device acceptance.
